title: Fictional reservations: numbers and unknowns

input.text:
Mist Bay Book Corner is a fictional institution invented for this test, not a real service. Explain application, confirmation and collection using only these conventions; do not present them as real-world policy.
Application: readers submit a book title and contact details. Each session has exactly 8 places. Submitting a request does not guarantee a place.
Checking and confirmation: staff check the information and capacity within 12 hours after submission. A collection code is issued only after confirmation; it remains valid for 48 hours after issue. The checking window and code validity start from different events.
Collection and expiry: readers collect using a valid code. An expired code cannot be used. The brief defines no extension, waitlist, fees, refunds, location or real calendar date.
When a requested detail is undefined, state that the material does not supply it rather than inventing a service promise.
